title: Senior Backend Engineer (Go)
description: We are scaling our distributed platform and need a Senior Backend Engineer who will own services end-to-end, from design through deployment. You will build high-throughput Go services backed by PostgreSQL and Kafka, and ship infrastructure with Kubernetes and Terraform. You will also mentor mid-level engineers, drive system design discussions, and participate in the on-call rotation to keep our services healthy. Join us to have a direct impact on reliability and performance at scale.
